verification.content_match: Lines 864-882 define updateSessionModelMode; body is a set() call that updates Zustand state via updatedSessions and returns new state. No call to saveSessionModelModes anywhere in that block. Compare to updateSessionPermissionMode at lines 834-862 which includes explicit allModes collection (lines 847-853) and saveSessionPermissionModes(allModes) call at line 856. The asymmetry is exactly as BA claims.

applySession_verification.content_match: Lines 310-339 contain the applySession sessions.forEach block. Line 312 loads savedPermissionModes; lines 325-332 resolve permissionMode via 4-priority chain (existingPermissionMode || savedPermissionMode || session.permissionMode || defaultPermissionMode); line 338 assigns permissionMode to mergedSessions[session.id]. No parallel savedModelModes load, no parallel modelMode resolution, no modelMode assignment. BA's gap claim is correct.

Lines 204-206 define saveSessionPermissionModes(modes) using mmkv.set('session-permission-modes', JSON.stringify(modes)). Exact pattern BA references as the copy source.

point_1_persistence.spec_statement: Each session must remember the model the user last selected; navigating away and returning must NOT revert to default
point_1_persistence.ba_coverage: Covered by R1, R2, R4 in Requirements section. AC1 and AC4 encode it as Given/When/Then. R3 (applySession 4-priority chain) is the specific implementation mechanism.

point_2_status_bar_chip_left_of_yolo.spec_statement: The currently selected model must be displayed in the status bar on the right side, immediately to the LEFT of the yolo (permission-mode) indicator
point_2_status_bar_chip_left_of_yolo.ba_coverage: Covered by R5 which specifies 'insert a model chip View immediately BEFORE the permission badge View' in AgentInput.tsx:877-902. AC2 encodes the visual requirement. Style requirements (gap: 4, flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center') match the permission-badge sibling.

point_3_manual_only_changes.spec_statement: Only user manual GUI switch triggers model change — no implicit/automatic changes on re-entry/reload/reconnect/machine-restart/app-restart
point_3_manual_only_changes.ba_coverage: Covered by R4 in decomposition table: 'Only updateSessionModelMode (called from onModelModeChange in the GUI) triggers a change to the stored model key. Navigation, reconnect, reload, and background activity do NOT alter the stored key.' AC4 encodes this as Given/When/Then. Won't-Have list explicitly excludes automatic model changes on reconnect/reload/machine-restart. BA also handles the default-key skip (saves don't include 'default') which prevents clutter but doesn't reintroduce defaults.

summary.rationale: BA's §5.1 spec is a high-quality, source-verified, decomposed delivery. All four QA validation dimensions pass: (D1) evidence — BA cited exact lines in storage.ts (864-882 missing MMKV write, 310-339 missing savedModelModes lookup) and persistence.ts (191-206 reference pattern), all independently verified against the actual files in this worktree. (D2) scope — all three spec §5.1 acceptance points (persistence, status-bar chip LEFT of yolo, manual-only changes) are covered by R1-R5 requirements and AC1-AC4 acceptance criteria, with no shrinkage. (D3) investigation — Technical Hints section contains a complete permission-mode-vs-model-mode contract table with 11 rows covering updater/MMKV key/load-time override/status bar hooks, each mapping the existing artifact to the new artifact with line-number precision. (D4) file accuracy — all 6 file paths (storage.ts, persistence.ts, AgentInput.tsx, SessionView.tsx, modelModeOptions.ts, storageTypes.ts) exist at the referenced paths, and every referenced line number was verified against actual source content. No fabrication, no inaccuracy.
risks_or_watchouts: BA inferred root cause from source-reading only (no Playwright observation). This is acceptable here because the gap is a pure plumbing symmetry break (updater writes to Zustand but not MMKV; load doesn't exist; resolution doesn't include MMKV-sourced override) — source-reading gives definitive proof. Dev should still have QA verify the fix in live browser on desktop + mobile per standard §5.1 E2E requirement.

R5 technical detail (d) mandates 'share the same gap: 4, flexDirection: row, alignItems: center style as the permission badge' — dev must verify the chip placement respects RTL and small-viewport reflow (the existing permission badge is on the right edge of an alignItems: center View with flex: 1 sibling, which should accommodate a chip before it; but QA should confirm on 390x844 mobile that the chip + badge together don't overflow).
